batches.title: Package skeleton and task schema
batches.added: The cmeval package, the task schema (the answer key), the dev/test split rule, and cmeval validate.

batches.title: Diff reader and code time machine
batches.added: patches.py reads a fix diff and aligns hunks to the base file. repos.py gives any file at any commit from a bare clone.

batches.title: The labeler
batches.added: labels.py finds the gold files, classes, and functions that a fix changed, with tree-sitter.

batches.title: SWE-bench Verified importer
batches.added: importers/swebench.py and the first answer key, tasks/swebv-dev50.jsonl (50 dev tasks).

batches.title: Review fixes
batches.added: 9 fixes from the code review. Labeler version 2 (cmeval-labels/2).

batches.title: The plug
batches.added: retriever.py (Retriever, Hit, IndexReport, check_hits), systems.py (system configs), and a fake system for tests.

batches.title: grep and grep-fn
batches.added: The two grep baselines and the keyword extractor. grep returns files; grep-fn returns the functions around the matching lines.

batches.title: codemem adapter
batches.added: adapters/codemem.py plugs codemem into the suite through the same interface.

batches.title: Review fixes
batches.added: Adapter fixes from the code review. F2 merged in PR #3.

batches.title: The runner
batches.added: run.py runs every task on every system, moves one index forward through commits, and saves the hits.

batches.title: Metrics and scoring
batches.added: metrics/ (matching, accuracy, tokens, latency) and score.py. The match rule from Decision 2 is now code.

batches.title: Runs from another machine
batches.added: cmeval score --tasks FILE scores a run made on another machine. Clones keep line endings as they are.

batches.title: Report and first numbers
batches.added: Planned: cmeval report, paired tests, and the first full run.
